title: The White half of the mutual chase alone is a unilateral perpetual chase
rationale: White's two chariots alternate as the discovered attacker on the unprotected black cannon on b5 — e5 attacks it once the horse vacates c5, b1 once the horse returns and unblocks the b-file — so every White move renews the attack on one and the same piece from a square that piece was not attacked from before the move. Black's horse shuttle e3/f5 attacks nothing and renews nothing; the black cannon's own threat on an undefended white chariot is produced by White's moves and alternates between two different pieces, which is a chase of neither. Red therefore loses at the third occurrence; this is the White half of mx-mix-002 in isolation.
